summary: Diginex Ltd, a UK-domiciled Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a proxy statement/EGM notice) for an Extraordinary General Meeting on October 8, 2026, seeking shareholder approval of its acquisition of Resulticks Global Companies Pte. Limited under an Amended and Restated Sale and Purchase Agreement dated August 14, 2026. Consideration is 600,000,000 newly issued ordinary shares plus a related change-of-control approval under Nasdaq Rule 5635(b) and an increase in authorized share capital. Record date August 14, 2026; materials mailed on or about September 24, 2026. Board recommends the proposals. Watch for dilution overhang and Nasdaq listing compliance.
